description: Retrieve full or filtered content from stored condensed result(s). Supports single `result_id` or batch `result_ids`, `contains`/`regex`/`fields` filtering, and raw (default) or JSON output.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on rows or lines.

fields.description: JSON columns/fields to keep per matched item.

format.description: Raw text (default, compact) or legacy JSON wrapper.

regex.description: Case-insensitive regex filter on rows or lines.

name: hub__get_full_result

description:
Required before any child tool. Pick the playbook that matches the user's input and pass it with the project and env; or declare the child server IDs and planned steps yourself. Returns a hub_plan_id to pass with every later call, the steps to follow, the log targets, and each child's rules. The Hub then refuses calls outside the plan: other children or tools, another environment, organization, or stream, a larger limit, undeclared writes, connection checks before a failure, and identical repeats.
Playbooks:
- jira-ticket-bug: The user gives a Jira issue key or URL for a bug and wants its cause.
- pr-review: The user gives a Bitbucket pull request URL and wants a correctness review of its changes.
- rcid-bug: The user gives an rcid, request ID, or correlation ID and wants to know why that request failed.
- service-errors: The user names a service (and maybe a time) and wants to know what is failing in it, without an rcid.
- source-search: The user asks to search or count code in a registered source repository, such as functions, text, or patterns.
- ticket-review: The user wants to review a Jira ticket for missing requirements, confirmations, API or stored-procedure changes, and related feature impact against confirmed BE/database/optional FE sources.

client.description: Optional AI client identifier (e.g. antigravity, claude-code, codex, cursor) when MCP clientInfo is generic.

confirm_token.description: The token from the offer of playbooks, sent with the playbook the user chose.

connection_checks.description: True only when the user asked to check connections.

continue_from.description: Same-scope predecessor after the user permits exact additional cache-refresh writes.

env.description: The environment the user named (dev, stg, prod); keep it for the task.

execute_model.description: Confirmed fast subagent model for bounded tool-execution stages.

execution_mode.description: Confirmed session execution mode: multi_agent or single_agent.

orchestrate_model.description: Confirmed model for planning, user interaction, and final synthesis.

playbook.description: The playbook that matches the user's input (listed above).

project.description: The project alias (see hub__list_projects); log playbooks need it.

rcid.description: Required request/correlation ID for rcid-bug workflow.

servers.description: Child server IDs this task needs (see hub__status).

since.description: UTC window for log/SQL time filters.

steps.description: The planned calls in order; group independent reads into one hub__batch step.

task.description: The user's request, in one or two sentences.

until.description: UTC window for log/SQL time filters.

writes.description: Tools that may write, only those the user explicitly asked for.

name: hub__plan

description: Show detected child MCPs and whether each is connected, disabled, or needs credentials.
name: hub__status

description: Inspect a playbook workflow, provide missing user context, report findings with receipt refs, or finish. Follow status missing_inputs, required_writes, allowed_tools and report_options. Ask the user before log time selection or write-capable cache reads/refresh. Fill locked context once; use continue_from in hub__plan after permission for additional refresh writes. Findings are client-reported. For ticket-review, select registered be_project/db_project/optional fe_project and optional related_issue_keys, wait for user confirmation, then report sources_confirmed before additional ticket or source reads. Finish supported only at ready, otherwise insufficient/blocked. Never invent refs.
name: hub__workflow
